newsitem.title: USA: Computer Network Technology CFO to resign.
newsitem.headline: Computer Network Technology CFO to resign.

text.p: Computer Network Technology Corp said Tuesday that John Brintnall, vice president of finance, chief financial officer and treasurer, would leave the company in mid-December to become chief financial officer at Integ Inc.

Computer Network Technology said Jeffrey Bertelsen, the company's controller since 1995, was promoted to corporate controller and treasurer, reporting to Thomas Hudson, president and chief executive officer.
Hudson will serve as acting chief financial officer.
Computer Technology develops high-performance networking products.
Integ is a medical company that is developing a painless and bloodless hand-held glucose monitoring product for use by diabetics.
